stemMd: A neutral atom has electron distribution 2, 8, 1 across its occupied shells. Which description is most consistent with its chemistry?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It typically forms a 1− ion by gaining seven electrons.

options.label: B
options.textMd: It is a noble gas with a filled outer shell.

options.label: C
options.textMd: It tends to form a 1+ ion by losing its outer electron.

explanationMd: The atom has a single outer electron beyond a filled inner shell. Losing that electron gives a stable cation configuration, typical of an alkali metal.

distractorRationale.a: Gaining seven would not produce a 1− ion.
distractorRationale.b: The outer shell contains only one electron.
distractorRationale.e: Eight belongs to the next inner shell here.
